ns2:course.label: Res Topics in Operations Mgt
ns2:course.description: Current and classical literature in the area of Operations Management. The topics covered may vary from year to year and may include performance measures, inventory management, planning, scheduling, location, layout, product design, process design, and forecasting. May be repeated in the same or separate terms. Prerequisite: Ph.D. standing in BADM or consent of instructor.
